meta.frozen_rule: canonical 5'TOP: transcript +1 base C and uninterrupted C/T pyrimidine run from +1 with run length >=7; top_score is run length
meta.leakage_guard: measured TE is outcome only; frozen 5'TOP sequence rule uses hg19 5'UTR sequence and is not fit or threshold-tuned on Hsieh2012

source.sequence: UCSC hg19 per-chromosome FASTA, fetched chromosome-by-chromosome

meta.te_definition: log2(fp/mrna)_PP242 - log2(fp/mrna)_DMSO, replicate means, min raw count >=10 in all 8 DMSO/PP242 mRNA/footprint samples
